q.line: And you read your Emily Dickinson
stanza: And you read your Emily Dickinson
And we note our place with bookmarkers
We are verses out of rhythm

q.line: And my impression of my best Angie Dickenson
stanza: Don’t make me scratch on your door, I never left you for a banjo
I only just turned around for a poodle and a corvette
And my impression of my best Angie Dickenson
But now I’ve got to worry
